plan.title: Vendor Accepts Counter Offer Then Revises

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with Vendor A's existing normal bid on the buyer's Responses screen.
Open Master QCS, which is required before sending a counter offer.
Buyer sends Vendor A a counter offer at 90.
Verify that the buyer's counter offer was initiated for the vendor's bid.
Have Vendor A accept the pending counter offer in the supplier portal.
Verify on the buyer side that Vendor A's counter offer is marked accepted.
Continue in Vendor A's supplier-portal session to test the post-acceptance revision.
Open the prepared RFQ pricing round for Vendor A.
Have Vendor A attempt to revise the accepted bid to 88 while the round is still live.
Verify whether the revised vendor quote was accepted and submitted.
